summary: Lighting review: reuse the accepted procedural HDR, lime/purple rim lights, ACES exposure1 and neutral/grazing validation modes. New curved optics and capped shell edges catch controlled white/neon highlights; dark metal cavities retain contrast and brushing. Four material comparisons pass (glass .8890, titanium .9679, emerald .8949, prism .7762). The original fluorescent core plus internal procedural-density backing remains readable in actual component-hidden tests: 6408 closed, 7141 opening and 1376 deployed green pixels, each above its unchanged projected-area threshold. New permanent open retaining clips preserve the +60-degree/+8-degree inspection sightline. Closed/deployed Tier1, turntables, self-intersection and phase/contact checks pass; nested real-time transmission remains approximate. Measured runtime files are authoritative: 185808 model triangles before optimization and 153 PBR calls including transmission. The draw budget remains an explicit Task8 item. Automatic application motion and lifecycle are still unaccepted until Task7.

features.notes: Curved closed glass and permanently open-sided retaining clips separate clear optics from metal without changing the seven-group inventory.

Real component-hidden footprint tests pass for the closed hero, intermediate opening and full reference-angle inspection; density-backed internal fluorescence retains the approved core geometry/material.
Four retained clips per new cell meet their radial support arms; all 28 rail sockets and 16 linkage arms remain within measured tolerances.
Capped housing sectors and retainer clips remain closed; independent topology, winding and sampled self-intersection checks pass.
Preserved exterior glass/green/shard identity and absolute phase poses; automatic app scheduling remains Task 7.
